name: qRustICP (Rust ICP via cc-rust)
description: ICP registration that runs the pure-Rust ICP from cc-rust/ on the selected model + data clouds. Uses subprocess execution of the cc_rust_cli binary. D9 cell-code-ordered NN is the default; kiddo is also available.

references.text: Phase 0 → live CXX FFI (D10): cc-rust CXX bridge to CCCoreLib::ICPRegistrationTools
cc-rust (Rust port of CCCoreLib compute kernels)
